about.title: About EverFlow Experience
about.description: EverFlow Experience is a boutique alpine travel company founded in 2022 by Juan Rodrigo Fernandez, a former member of the Argentinian Ski Team. Based in Munich, hosted across the Alps.
about.h1: The days you remember are the ones built around you.
story: EverFlow Experience was founded in 2022 by Juan Rodrigo Fernandez, a former member of the Argentinian Ski Team. What began as a ski school has grown into complete, tailor-made alpine trips.
From private coaching on snow to hotels, chalets, dining, wellness and transfers, every trip is planned around one group at a time, with local knowledge and the mountain culture of each place.
We are based in Munich and host across the Alps. Our trips are multilingual and fully tailored: race-honed technique, and the kind of hosting that turns a trip into a story people want to tell.
about.how_text: We host, plan and coordinate. On the mountain we work with licensed instructors and guides, and with local partners where the rules of a country require it, so the standard is the same in every destination. EverFlow Experience is a member of the German Ski Instructors Association (DSLV).
about.credential_alt: Profi Ski: award of the German Ski Instructors Association (DSLV) for ski schools
